FAQ

Common questions

Can ABiT integrate SAP Business One with third-party systems?

Yes. ABiT builds integrations using SAP Business One Service Layer, B1if, APIs, scheduled jobs and custom middleware depending on the use case.

Do you build SAP Business One add-ons?

Yes. ABiT develops add-ons and portals for workflows such as payroll, quality, gate pass, approvals, WMS, reporting and customer or vendor access.

Can you host and support SAP Business One?

Yes. ABiT provides managed hosting, backup, monitoring, performance support and ongoing enhancements for SAP Business One environments.
